an10.220:1.1: athakho aññataro brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi
an10.220:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an10.220:1.3: ko nu kho bho gotama hetu ko paccayo yenamidhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjantīti.
an10.220:1.4: adhammacariyavisamacariyāhetu kho brāhmaṇa evamidhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjantīti.
an10.220:2.1: ko pana bho gotama hetu ko paccayo yenamidhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjantīti.
an10.220:2.2: dhammacariyasamacariyāhetu kho brāhmaṇa evamidhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā paramamaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjanti.
an10.220:3.1: na kho ahaṃ imassa bhoto gotamassa saṃkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmi
an10.220:3.2: sādhu me bhavaṃ gotamo tathā dhammaṃ desetu yathāhaṃ imassa bhoto gotamassa saṃkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājāneyyanti.
an10.220:3.3: tenahi brāhmaṇa suṇāhi sādhukaṃ manasikarohi bhāsissāmīti.
an10.220:3.4: evaṃ bhoti kho so brāhmaṇo bhagavato paccassosi.
an10.220:4.1: tividhaṃ kho brāhmaṇa kāyena adhammacariyavisamacariyā hoti
an10.220:5.1: kathañca brāhmaṇa tividhaṃ kāyena adhammacariyavisamacariyā hoti …pe…
an10.220:5.2: evaṃ kho brāhmaṇa tividhaṃ kāyena adhammacariyavisamacariyā hoti.
an10.220:6.1: kathañca brāhmaṇa catubbidhaṃ vācāya adhammacariyavisamacariyā hoti …pe…
an10.220:6.2: evaṃ kho brāhmaṇa catubbidhaṃ vācāya adhammacariyavisamacariyā hoti.
an10.220:7.1: kathañca brāhmaṇa tividhaṃ manasā adhammacariyavisamacariyā hoti …pe…
an10.220:7.2: evaṃ kho brāhmaṇa tividhaṃ manasā adhammacariyavisamacariyā hoti
an10.220:7.3: evaṃ adhammacariyavisamacariyāhetu kho brāhmaṇa evamidhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti.
an10.220:8.1: tividhaṃ kho brāhmaṇa kāyena dhammacariyasamacariyā hoti
an10.220:9.1: kathañca brāhmaṇa tividhaṃ kāyena dhammacariyasamacariyā hoti …pe…
an10.220:9.2: evaṃ kho brāhmaṇa tividhaṃ kāyena dhammacariyasamacariyā hoti
an10.220:10.1: kathañca brāhmaṇa catubbidhaṃ vācāya dhammacariyasamacariyā hoti …pe…
an10.220:10.2: evaṃ kho brāhmaṇa catubbidhaṃ vācāya dhammacariyasamacariyā hoti
an10.220:11.1: kathañca brāhmaṇa tividhaṃ manasā dhammacariyasamacariyā hoti …pe…
an10.220:11.2: evaṃ kho brāhmaṇa tividhaṃ manasā dhammacariyasamacariyā hoti
an10.220:11.3: evaṃ dhammacariyasamacariyāhetu kho brāhmaṇa evamidhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjantīti.
an10.220:12.2: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃgatanti.
